composition_label: sentiment -> normal research -> adaptive onboarding -> behavioral personalization

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory using synthetic fixtures

shared_schema.input: Exact root fields: schema_version, synthetic=true, timezone-aware now, customer, issues, sources, steps, products, events. See example_input.json for the complete nested schema.
shared_schema.output: schema_version, synthetic=true, status=ok, stages containing sentiment, research, onboarding, behavior in execution order
shared_schema.errors: One JSON object with status=error and error message; CLI exit 2. Success exits 0.
shared_schema.validation: Shared require/fields/text/strings/number/records validators; validate_input checks uniqueness, enums, finite numbers, references, timezone-aware timestamps and acyclic prerequisites. validate_stage validates each handoff before the next stage executes, including exact citation offsets and dependency order.

cross_stage_handoffs.payload: Severity-first ordered issues and tokenized query_terms drive passage retrieval and issue provenance.
Cited source topics become focus_categories; matched issue IDs carry forward. With no findings, explicit customer interests are the fallback.
Validated focus_categories supply an explicit ranking boost, combined with browsing/purchase history and customer interests.

behavior.sentiment: Case-insensitive ASCII word lexicon; not/no/never within two preceding tokens reverses polarity. Score is mean matched contribution, or zero. Priority is descending severity, ascending sentiment score, then issue ID; severity is caller-supplied.
behavior.research: Split source text at sentence punctuation/newlines; rank by distinct non-stopword query overlap, tie-break by source ID and start offset. Extract at most two passages per issue. Citations contain source_id, exact quote and zero-based half-open Unicode character offsets. No overlap means unanswered, never fabricated.
behavior.onboarding: Choose matching-category steps at or below experience level; include transitive prerequisites even above that level; omit completed steps. Topological scheduling prefers requested format among ready steps, then level and ID. Every step explains selection and format fallback.
behavior.personalization: Category affinity sums browse=1 and purchase=3, decayed with a 30-day half-life. Product score = category affinity + 0.5 onboarding focus + 0.25 explicit interest + 0.1 popularity. Ties use product ID. Cold-start omits history and uses remaining components; no interests or research yields popularity-only ranking.
behavior.determinism: No random state, current-clock dependency, external providers, or LLM calls; all time calculations use input now. Input is not mutated.
behavior.empty_data: Empty collections accepted if references remain valid; empty catalog produces an empty ranking.
